requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4871-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4871-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with MV>=4 that has a generic mana cost

866-5220-6495--66.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone enough times to cast the creature with MV>=4  for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
866-5220-6495--66.description:
Cast the creature with MV>=4 for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the creature's trigger, causing you to draw it from the top of your library.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
866-5220-6495--66.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3629-4417-8089.easyPrerequisites:
Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
Your life total is even.
3629-4417-8089.description:
Activate Hex Parasite by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-5662-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reyhan.
When Reyhan dies, its persist ability and innate ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reyhan from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the innate trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on a creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-3699-5434.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
3259-3699-5434.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Auton Soldier and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3755-4478-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3755-4478-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-4478-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1624-6555-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

792-5231-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
792-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Totentanz and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-5078-6766.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
4668-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5475-5921-5970-7175.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

49-341-2034-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Umori.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5007-6797-6972.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-549-4853-5147.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Biotransference, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2486-5641-5662.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to Master Chef.
When Basking Broodscale enters, it triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to your commander.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to your commander.
Repeat from step 3.

2541-4017-4703.notablePrerequisites:
Brallin has lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
2541-4017-4703.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Brallin triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat from step 2.

3362-4753.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Clever Impersonator
3362-4753.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Clever Impersonator's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is a creature without summoning sickness

478-539-3291--111.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

478-804-1460-2821-3488.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
478-804-1460-2821-3488.description:
Animate Candelabra using Katsumasa
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

1247-1253-5536.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Gyre Engineer and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-1253-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Gyre Engineer's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

976-1742-2042.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
976-1742-2042.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Golgari Brownscale, adding {B}.
Activate Greed by paying {B} and 2 life, causing you to mill two cards and return Golgari Brownscale from your graveyard to your hand.
Golgari Brownscale triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

997-2730-3719-5131.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya's Ghostform attached to Muldrotha.
You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn if Ruthless Technomancer is in your graveyard.
997-2730-3719-5131.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer either from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Muldrotha and create six Treasure artifact tokens.
When Muldrotha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer, causing you to scry 1.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Muldrotha.
Repeat.

1737-2544-3390-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Filigree Sages.
1737-2544-3390-5149.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Lotus Bloom.
Activate the Lotus Bloom token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1887-3663-5193.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1887-3663-5193.description:
Cast Anikthea either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Three Blind Mice from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 3/3 Zombie in addition to its other types.
The Three Blind Mice token enters the battlefield with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex, triggering its first and second chapter abilities.
Resolve the first Three Blind Mice trigger, creating a 1/1 Mouse creature token.
Resolve the second Three Blind Mice trigger, creating a token copy of the Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat from step 3.

1625-2607.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least twenty life.
1625-2607.description:
Cast Magister Sphinx by paying {4}{W}{U}{B}.
When Magister Sphinx enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing an opponent with at least twenty life to lose life until their life total is equal to ten.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent targeted by Magister Sphinx in step 1 loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1171-2104-2963.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast a copy of Regrowth using Garth's ability.
Garth does not have summoning sickness.
1171-2104-2963.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Garth by tapping it, causing you to pay {1}{G} to cast a copy of Regrowth.
Resolve Regrowth, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Garth.
Repeat each turn.

721-2724-3154.notablePrerequisites: Linessa does not have summoning sickness.
721-2724-3154.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Linessa by paying {7}{U}{U} and tapping it, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

186-1409-4617-5115.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Soulbright Flamekin.
186-1409-4617-5115.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin 3 times paying {1} each time, adding eight {R} with the third activation.
Activate Gemstone Array for {2} to place a counter on it, then remove that conter to add {U}.
Pay {U} to activate the ability granted to Soulbright Flamekin by Deadeye Navigator, blinking it.
When it ETBs, pair it with Deadeye Navigator.
Repeat this process for infinite mana.
If you have another creature with an ETB, you can flicker Deadeye and pair it to that creature, then flicker that creature infinite times.
